jordan (AcmeCorp): Hi — hitting an analytics gap. Our EU dashboard for model redwood-v2-small shows zero requests for version v2026-03-15 since ~09:00 UTC but our API logs show steady traffic. Can you check?

maria (support-engineer): Sorry about that. Can you paste the exact model + version filter you used in the console? Also any org/role differences?

jordan (AcmeCorp): I filtered: region = EU, model = redwood-v2-small, version = v2026-03-15. Shared screenshot: https://acme.screens/abcd (internal only). API calls are returning 200 and logs show tokens.

maria (support-engineer): Thanks. Quick repro curl we can run to cross-check metrics ingestion:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics/query \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPO_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"filter": {"region":"eu", "model":"redwood-v2-small", "version":"v2026-03-15"}, "range": "1h"}'
```

maria (support-engineer): Can you run that from a box and paste the results?

jordan (AcmeCorp): Ran it, got time series with ~1200 tokens. So ingestion works. Console shows 0 for EU but global + us-east look fine.

eli (observability): Noted. Tagging observability. I'm pulling query logs for the console frontend -> metrics service.

deploy-bot: deploy started by sasha @ 2026-03-15T08:52:03Z: release/console-filtering-fix

eli (observability): Hmm — frontend is sending filter region as "eu-west" in the GraphQL payload while backend metric store expects canonical "eu". Example intercepted payload: `{"region":"eu-west","model":"redwood-v2-small","version":"v2026-03-15"}`.

maria (support-engineer): That smells like recently-introduced region aliasing in the console. Was there a change to region normalization in that deploy?

sasha (eng-runtime): Yes — the deploy included a small refactor: we added support for region labels like eu-west, eu-central and map them at query time. Looks like I updated the mapping table in frontend but forgot to publish the backend mapping layer. Frontend is now emitting alias keys that metric service doesn't recognize.

eli (observability): Exact symptom: metric store query uses `WHERE region IN ('eu')`, frontend used `region='eu-west'` so no match. Search logs show no fallback, defaulting to exact match.

maria (support-engineer): For a quick customer workaround, Jordan — can you try selecting region = All and then filter model+version? That should surface EU traffic while we fix the mapping.

jordan (AcmeCorp): Confirmed — All regions shows the expected numbers. Not ideal but works as a temporary workaround.

sasha (eng-runtime): I'll roll a hotfix to add alias fallback in metrics query path. Plan: add OR-clause mapping eu-west->eu and deploy to metrics service. ETA 45m.

eli (observability): Also adding a short-term alert to detect when frontend region values don't intersect with known backend keys. Will add logs to help root cause if it recurs.

maria (support-engineer): I'm going to update the support ticket and notify Jordan once the fix is live. Also asking PM to add a unit test during console e2e for region normalization.

sasha (eng-runtime): Patching now. Patch included: `metrics_query.add_fallback_regions(region_aliases)` and unit + integration tests.

eli (observability): Running a smoke query after patch - results look plausible locally. Will watch ingestion and dashboard for next 30 mins.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: metrics-service @ release/alias-backfill 2026-03-15T09:20:12Z

sasha (eng-runtime): Deployed. Rolling back changes if we see issues, otherwise I'll promote to canary->prod.

eli (observability): Can confirm dashboards starting to show EU numbers for v2026-03-15, matching API counts.

jordan (AcmeCorp): Thanks team — EU dashboard now shows expected traffic. Appreciate the quick turn.

maria (support-engineer): Follow-ups: (1) We'll keep the alert for 24h. (2) Eng to add e2e test and add mapping sync to deploy checklist. (3) We'll send a short incident note to account team.

sasha (eng-runtime): Ack. I'll create a PR to add mapping publish step to CI and include a release note so owners remember mapping state.

eli (observability): Putting a note on the console monitoring runbook about alias drift.

maria (support-engineer): Closing thread once Jordan confirms no further discrepancies over the next hour. :thumbsup:
